notes.title: The Islander: Town Architect is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/ea69fd3ebeec2e4743e9c46d32e80e2a3183144c.png

Hello islanders,

We just wanted to let you know that our new game and sequel to The Islander - The Islander: Town Architect is finally released on Steam, so  head to calm & exotic Polynesia to become a grand-master town architect.  To celebrate this occasion the game is 10% off.

You can get it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042160/

FEATURES
Design house exterior - choose the building type, elect the wanted roof and walls design, make sure windows and doors fits the overall look of the house, or go wild and create craziest designs.

Don't limit yourself to house designing only, landscape your town, after all you are TOWN ARCHITECT. Build pathways and fences, plant trees and shrubs, erect statues and fountains.

Expand and urbanize your island by building stores, agricultural and public buildings, like - libraries, tower bells and observatories.

Sizable catalog of items and decorations ranging from flowers and bushes to lighthouses and pyramids.

Relaxing atmosphere to ease your stressed-out mind.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hey there,

-The Islander is finally available in Russian! Thanks to Quton for providing translation.
-We also added an additional Display option, that allows to expand window size when playing in windowed mode.

More updates coming really soon.

7 Box Games

-v.1.0.2.0.
